# Silica Aerogel Insulation

> > ZhengZhou Joda Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures advanced silica aerogel insulation materials using supercritical fluid extraction technology for thermal management across industrial applications.

Joda is a Chinese aerogel manufacturer specializing in silica aerogel insulation blankets, powders, and particles for pipelines, automotive, refrigeration, and battery industries. The company leverages CO2 supercritical fluid extraction (SCFE) technology and partnerships with institutions like the Chinese Academy of Science and Central South University.

- Silica aerogel
- Aerogel insulation blanket
